metadata.description: Design apps in plain HTML instead of Figma: phone and desktop mockups on a per-project design system with a live WCAG contrast audit, App Store and Play screenshots, and app icons — all from one palette.

plugins.name: app-design
plugins.description: Four skills that share one engine and one palette: mobile-mockups (iOS/Android screens), desktop-mockups (macOS/Windows windows and menu-bar panels), store-screenshots (App Store, Play and Mac App Store graphics with exact-size export), and app-icon (concepts, platform variants, export).
